witness_semantics: witness/<aid>.py runs the artifact's solve.py, then checks: every job assigned exactly once, every worker at most one task, W2 is not assigned to J3, reported objective equals the cost recomputed from data/costs.csv and equals the brute-force reference optimum (tolerance 1e-6).

correct.description: Correct MIP: one-to-one assignment plus the W2-J3 exclusion.

a_m1.description: The W2-J3 exclusion constraint is missing; the optimum uses W2->J3 with objective 27 < 34 and violates the business rule.

a_m2.description: The exclusion is written for W2-J4 instead of W2-J3; the optimum still uses W2->J3 (illegal) with objective 27.

a_e1.description: Equivalent rewrite: different model organization (dict-driven variables, forbidden pair fixed via upper bound), same constraint set.
